'''Wicket33 Another Hunt-Down deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Wicket33]]
* '''Published:''' 12 June 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS2]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS2 HD Wicket33 DS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Hunt-down designed for controlling the opponent's destiny, force activation, and using every weapon to kill them.

== Strategy ==

First the Vaders: I only have three in my collection, I use TEB to pull them from reserve deck, plus its a destiny 3 over a destiny 1. My primary goal is battle. I have a problem if I do not get three battle destiny in any battle. I also use Wounded Wookiee to reduce the destiny draws against me. I have Molator because most people in my area play with weapons and interrupts to make characters lost after hit. The destiny draws are decent, and win me most battles and duels. Thanks for reading.
